sources.snippet: Whisper large-v3-turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large-v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4. As a result, the model is way faster, at the expense of a minor quality degradation. sources.title: Whisper Large v3 Turbo — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: This OpenASR repo repackages the original openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo weights as .oasr packs that run natively in the OpenASR runtime with no Python at inference time. For most users the q8_0 build is the recommended default; q4_k is for tighter memory budgets and fp16 is for verification or maximum fidelity.
